Class UriListHttpMessageConverter

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.data.rest.webmvc.convert.UriListHttpMessageConverter
All Implemented Interfaces:
HttpMessageConverter<RepresentationModel<?>>
public class UriListHttpMessageConverter extends Object implements HttpMessageConverter<RepresentationModel<?>>
将 Converter 用于渲染 RepresentationModel 中包含的所有 Link 为 text/uri-list，并将该媒体类型的请求解析回 RepresentationModel 实例。
Author:
